title: Manufacturing Operations Director
text:
**Manufacturing Operations Lead**
responsible for end-to-end scaling of radar hardware production—from building capacity and optimizing facilities to developing teams, supplier relationships, and robust quality systems. This role sets the operational foundation needed to support rapid growth while maintaining the standards required for mission-critical performance.
 
 
Working closely with engineering, supply chain, and program leaders, you will industrialize new and evolving designs, translate technical requirements into scalable manufacturing processes, and drive continuous improvement in cost, throughput, and yield. You’ll also strengthen supplier networks to ensure consistent materials and components, and you’ll establish/advance quality controls, documentation, and inspection processes that reduce risk and support delivery commitments.
 
 
**What You’ll Bring**

* Proven leadership in manufacturing operations scaling—capacity planning, process improvement, and team development
* Strong quality mindset with practical experience building quality systems for hardware production
* Ability to partner across engineering, supply chain, and program functions to industrialize products
* Experience managing supplier networks and performance to protect production continuity
* Hands-on, problem-solving approach to improving production performance and execution
